messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A quadrupedal creature with the body, head, fur, legs and paws of a brown bear standing in three-quarter view facing right. Its brown shaggy fur covers the torso, head and four thick legs. Fused into the shoulders, neck and chest are multiple glossy dark reddish-brown beetle wing-covers with large translucent veined membranous insect wings extending outward from the sides. The rear bears a long segmented glossy dark arthropod tail curving downward ending in two claws, and the flanks have rows of narrow slit-like openings in the fur.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown furry bear head with lighter tan muzzle, dark nose, and small brown eyes", "part": "head", "where": "at the front top of the body facing to the right"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry brown ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head"}, {"looks_like": "thick shaggy brown furry bear legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in rear supporting the body"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry paws with long pale claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "long segmented glossy dark reddish-brown arthropod tail with small side points and two claw-like prongs at the tip", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body curving downward"}, {"looks_like": "large translucent tan membranous insect wings with dark brown veins", "part": "wings", "where": "one protruding from each side of the shoulder and chest area and extending outward"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark reddish-brown oval beetle wing-covers", "part": "shell", "where": "clustered on the top and sides of the shoulders and chest around the wing bases, including one large cover on each side"}, {"looks_like": "narrow dark slit-like openings in the fur", "part": "markings", "where": "on the side of the torso in a diagonal row on the hindquarter and a vertical row on the mid-flank"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 2}
